					}
				}
			}
			# Preserve the exact item and its three original buttons after any
			# tuple-guard, dependency or resource failure.
			scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.238 days = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked value = 1 }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_fallback_mid value = 238 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked }
					var:zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked = 0
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				root = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode = 3
				}
			}
			root = { change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_policy_debt_disclosed_n add = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked }
				var:zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_receipt_choice }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				root = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode = 1
				}
			}
			zg361_p3_m239_route_a_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode = 2
				}
			}
			zg361_p3_m239_route_b_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				root = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode = 3
				}
			}
			zg361_p3_m239_route_c_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner
				TICKET_SUBJECT = scope:zg361_p3_aa_subject
				TICKET_CYCLE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_cycle
				TICKET_CASE = scope:zg361_p3_aa_case
			}
		}
		else = {
			# Missing/invalid mode is itself a reason to fall back to the original card.
			scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.239 days = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked }
					var:zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked = 0
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				NOT = {
					AND = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
						var:zg361_p3_runtime_applied = 1
					}
				}
			}
			# Preserve the exact item and its three original buttons after any
			# tuple-guard, dependency or resource failure.
			scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.239 days = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked value = 1 }
			root = { set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_batch_fallback_mid value = 239 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked }
					var:zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked = 0
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
				root = {
					has_variable = zg361_p3_player_batch_mode
					var:zg361_p3_player_batch_mode = 3
				}
			}
			root = { change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_policy_debt_disclosed_n add = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked }
				var:zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked = 0
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
			NOT = { has_variable = zg361_p3_m241_receipt_choice }
		}
		scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.241 days = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked value = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_player_dispatch_blocked
}

zg361_p3_aa_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_aa_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		zg361_p3_initialize_portfolio_effect = yes
		zg361_p3_aa_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_aa_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aa_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aa_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aa_cycle value = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aa_case value = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_p3_aa_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.9000 } }
		}
	}
}
